variants.title: e/m of the electron by the bar magnet method
variants.sample: Cathode-ray tube at 250 V, a bar magnet and a deflection magnetometer
variants.note: The magnet's field across the tube bends the beam into a circular arc; the same field is then read with a deflection magnetometer as B = BH tan(theta). Earth's horizontal field BH = 35 microtesla is from memory - verify for your site; the magnet moment and tube length are illustrative. A low-precision method: expect a few per cent.
